entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker used as an example of one summoned from a far-off plane who consults demonic forces for a spell of her own.

entities.name: Garruk's Companion
entities.description: A little trampling beast imagined with deathtouch as an unstoppable force.

entities.name: Darksteel Colossus
entities.description: An enormous darksteel construct knocked aside in the author's imagined clash with Garruk's Companion.

entities.name: Arc Runner
entities.description: A lightning elemental shaped like a bull, an onrushing elemental made of lightning.

entities.name: Merfolk
entities.description: Aquatic race depicted with finned legs rather than fish-tails since Magic 2010.
